BUILD WHERE THE WORLD PLAYS

Build and scale social games and experiences where millions of friends are looking for fun things to do.

Get Started
Inherently Social, Uniquely Discord
With the Embedded App SDK, developers have the power to reach millions of users by creating rich, immersive and interactive experiences that live directly within Discord.
Interactive Games
Create immersive multiplayer games to compete with friends, collaborate, or get the conversation started.
Image and Video Remixing
Create generative AI apps that inspire the group chat with animation, image editing, and video remixing.
Listen and Watch Parties
Transform music, podcasts, audiobooks, radio, and videos into shared experiences with friends.
Game Integrations
Connect players with their favourite games. Leaderboards, stats, and shareable moments keep the fun going outside the game.
The Totally Uncategorisable
Share cat facts. Water and grow a virtual tree with your friends. Show off your skills by catching and selling fish. Spice up the chat with Truth or Dare. Bring fun to the chat in unexpected ways.
“The Embedded App SDK was very easy to get started with. We had a build of our game running within a day of getting access to the platform.”
ASSAD ALI, PLAYROOM CTO
BUILD AND SHIP LIGHTNING FAST
Our Embedded App SDK makes it quick and easy to ship native web apps, games, and interactive experiences.
View Documentation
GET DISCOVERED
Right in Chat
Show up where people hang out. Friends can instantly see what's happening and play together, no install necessary.
In the Directory
Publish your app to the Directory to get discovered, set up shop, and promote your app right inside of Discord.
On any Device
Apps are instantly available on every device for people to find, use, and keep coming back to.
GROW YOUR BUSINESS

A better path to product-market fit
From idea to launch, it all lives on Discord. Grow a tight-knit community of early adopters who provide feedback and champion what you build. Reach them and their friends with every new feature and update.

Hassle-free payments
Take advantage of Discord's integrated payment systems that users know, trust and already use. Focus on innovation rather than financial logistics.

GET INSPIRED

Join pioneers like Midjourney, FRVR and Playroom who have built thriving businesses on Discord.
